notes.title: Hold 10 Seconds 1.01 - Minor fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes for Hold 10 Seconds 1.01[/h1]

[list]
[*] Faster respawn - Removed "Menu --> Retry" between death and respawn. Respawn will be now automatic.

[*] Performance improved for lvl 20 and 40.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback! ː2018bestawardː
